description: This file defines a PHP class 'Module' within the namespace Opencart\'Catalog\'Model\'Setting'. The class provides methods to retrieve module settings from a database, specifically the method getModule which fetches settings for a given module ID.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A model class that interacts with the database to retrieve module configuration settings based on module ID.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the settings for a specific module from the database, decodes the JSON stored in the 'setting' field, and returns it as an array.
